clmrs.title: CLMRS
clmrs.subtitle: Child Labour Monitoring & Remediation. Review pending hazardous-work flags (Modules B & C) and manage the case register (Module D).
clmrs.flags.title: Pending Flags
clmrs.flags.subtitle: Hazardous-work observations flagged by Module B (household) or Module C (farm-visit) enumerators, awaiting IMS review.
clmrs.cases.title: Case Register
clmrs.cases.subtitle: Every open and closed CLMRS case. Module D visits update the last-visit date automatically; status is toggled manually here.
clmrs.detail.title: CLMRS Case
clmrs.detail.subtitle: A consolidated view of this child's labour-monitoring case — household and farm-visit findings, the current case status and the most recent follow-up visit.
clmrs.filters.searchPlaceholder: Search child, farmer, CLMRS code, cooperative…
clmrs.dialog.clmrsCodeAuto: Auto-assigned on submit — format CLMRS-YYYY-NNN, incremented per year.
clmrs.dialog.reopenBody: Set a follow-up date so this case comes back for a recheck.
clmrs.dialog.closeBody: Mark this case resolved. You can reopen it later if the situation recurs.
clmrs.dialog.createError: Couldn't open the case. Please try again.
clmrs.detail.statusClosedSub: Case has been resolved and closed
clmrs.detail.statusPendingSub: No case yet — create one to start remediation
clmrs.detail.caseBlockBody: Manual identity assigned by IMS staff. Module D visits update the last-visit date; status is toggled here.
clmrs.detail.caseBlockBodyEmpty: No CLMRS case has been opened for this child yet. Review the originating flag above, then open a case to start remediation tracking.
clmrs.detail.caseEmpty: No case yet — click "Create case" to open one.
clmrs.detail.householdBody: Whose household the child belongs to. Click the farmer ID to jump to their profile.
clmrs.detail.originatingFlagBody: The observation that prompted this case. Read-only — the flag row has been marked as "has_case" so it no longer appears in the Pending Flags queue.
clmrs.detail.originatingFlagBodyPending: Review the flagged activities below to determine whether this warrants opening a CLMRS case for remediation follow-up.
clmrs.detail.koboLink: Open the latest Module D submission in Kobo →
clmrs.detail.koboLinkAbsent: No Module D submission has landed for this case yet.
clmrs.empty.pending: No pending flags — every hazardous-work observation has been reviewed.
clmrs.empty.cases: No cases yet. Create one from the Pending Flags queue.
clmrs.empty.records: No CLMRS records match the current filters.
